messages:
Jordan (AM): FYI Acme Health said they're ready for a POC but with strict geo constraints: EU + Mexico-only for inference and embeddings. Their asks: 1) guarantee routing so data never leaves EU or MX for their tenant, 2) BYOK in both regions, 3) subprocessor inventory for MX/EU, 4) pricing delta for geo-pin / egress isolation.

Mira (SE): Short answers: we can do EU geo-pin on Hosted/Dedicated; Mexico-only pinning is not available on Hosted today. BYOK: supported for Dedicated & Private; hosted BYOK is limited and region-dependent. Need to confirm MX subprocessors.

Alex S (Security): Hosted subprocessors (EU): AWS eu-west-1/eu-central-1, GCP europe-west*, CDN provider (global). For MX: we currently rely on upstream cloud POPs in US/latam regions; we do NOT have a managed cluster physically in MX. If customer requires sovereign MX residency we must offer Private/on-prem or a partner VPC in MX (previously done as an exception). Will prepare subproc list + caveats.

Priya (Solutions): Option summary for the POC: Hosted API = fastest but cannot promise MX-only. Dedicated = better affinity, can pin to EU for main traffic; MX still not guaranteed without Private. Private/on-prem = can meet strict residency but needs SOW, lead time, infra.

Mira (SE): For the POC we can simulate MX-origin traffic via proxied edge POPs to demonstrate routing and measure latency. For production sovereign requirement we should scope Private deployment.

Jordan (AM): Customer wants a one-page subprocessor + routing note for legal, plus price deltas: geo-pin monthly add-on, BYOK setup/rotation, and high-level Private deployment provisioning estimate. Can someone draft?

Alex S (Security): I'll draft the one-pager listing subprocessors by region, the routing guarantees language, and security controls (KMS BYOK, audit logs, retention). Note: for Hosted we can promise "geographic affinity" but not strict MX-only residency.

Mira (SE): Quick pricing bands: geo-pin for Dedicated ~ +15-25% on committed monthly (depends on standby capacity), BYOK one-time setup ~ $8k-$15k (KMS/HSM complexity), Private on-prem baseline setup ~ $120k+ plus recurring infra. I'll convert to ranges for the POC quote.

presales-bot: New presales ticket created: PS-2025-119 - Acme Health geo-residency POC. Assignees: Mira (SE), Alex S (Security).

Jordan (AM): Next actions: Alex  prepare one-pager for legal by EOD tomorrow; Mira  include geo-pin pricing ranges and fallback behaviors in POC quote; Priya  schedule a network discussion with customer (CIDR, latency SLOs).

Priya (Solutions): I'll get a 30m slot for Thursday and request sample RPS, prompts, and whether embeddings are persisted. Also ask if they require customer-managed keys in EU/MX.

Alex S (Security): Draft routing wording suggestion for contract: `Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to route and process Customer Data within selected regions. Where Provider-controlled edge or provider limitations make strict country-only residency infeasible, Provider will document fallback paths and provide audit logs.`

Jordan (AM): Great. Drop the one-pager + quote link in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
